title: Polynomial-time sampling step
statement: The bit-string function that takes a state encoding, splits its encoded sample into a prefix of length given by the encoded state parameter and the remaining suffix, and updates the state and sample according to the specified comparison and binary-value rules is polynomial-time computable.
caveat: The supplied definitions do not explain the state and sample encoding or the comparison and update rules in informal mathematical terms; this description follows their formal construction only at a high level.
